Regarding the laboratory test results for Patient B:
The patient has a high LDL cholesterol level of 190 mg/dL, which is significantly above the optimal range (typically less than 100 mg/dL) and indicates an increased risk for cardiovascular diseases. However, their HDL cholesterol level is 55 mg/dL, which is considered within a healthy range (generally 40-60 mg/dL for men and 50-60 mg/dL for women), offering some protective benefit against heart disease. Overall, the high LDL remains a primary concern requiring medical attention.
